title: How to pass a kidney stone fast: drink 2 liters of urine
context: Someone Googled how to pass kidney stones quickly. AI Overview brought a closed-loop hydration plan.

exchanges.prompt: how to pass kidney stones quickly
exchanges.response: Drinking plenty of fluids, such as water, ginger ale, lemon-lime soda, or fruit juice, can help pass kidney stones more quickly. You should aim to drink at least 2 quarts (2 liters) of urine every 24 hours, and your urine should be light in color.

roast: Water, ginger ale, lemon-lime soda, or fruit juice. Then the recipe finishes with urine. That's not a beverage list, that's a crime scene.
"Aim to drink at least 2 liters of urine every 24 hours." The input and the output are the same liquid. Congratulations, you invented a kidney stone perpetual motion machine.
Mount Sinai and Comprehensive Urology are sitting right under the overview saying drink water. Gemini read those cards and still ordered the house urine.
Your urine should be light in color, which is easier when your primary fluid intake is... also urine. Circles within circles.
verdict: The only treatment plan that keeps you hydrated and dehydrated at the same time.
